name: Re:NewCell AB (publ)
summary: Re:Newcell AB operates as a textile recycling company in Sweden. It produces and sells dissolving pulp from recycled textiles under the Circulose brand name. The company's Circulose product is used as a raw material to produce regenerated fibers, such as viscose, modal, and lyocell. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
